description: Meta-schema of a golden transcript file (spec 19.20 'Schemas and conformance'): transcripts/<namespace>/<Rest>.<v>.json, the cases of one interface version, replayed by the conformance runner against any binary over the standard-I/O transport. The format (fixtures, the handshake, the steps, the selector and the matchers) is described in lua/loomworks/proto/conformance.lua (its header comment).

fixture.description: The workspace the runner prepares (default empty).

hello.description: Fields over the default hello of the handshake.

handshake.description: false: the case sends its own hello (no automatic handshake).

allow.description: Frames that may arrive unconsumed, any number of times.

malformed.description: The frame is deliberately invalid: not validated before sending.

Frame.description: A frame template (send) or pattern (expect, allow): a frame whose values may be matchers.
